mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the effort to reduce loss of life and property by lessening the impact of disasters and emergencies."
Mitigation is the effort to reduce loss of life and property by lessening the impact of disasters and emergencies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major element of disaster risk reduction."
Early warning is a major element of disaster risk reduction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document which provides a framework for ensuring compliance with regulations pertaining to protection of personnel and environment."
An Environmental health and safety plan is a document which provides a framework for ensuring compliance with regulations pertaining to protection of personnel and environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important element of the EHS plan."
Environmental Management Environmental management is a very important element of the EHS plan.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good way to protect employers, employees and the organizational business during an emergency (Chao and Henshaw, 2001)."
Compiling an emergency action plan is a good way to protect employers, employees and the organizational business during an emergency (Chao and Henshaw, 2001).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to measures taken to prepare for and reduce the effects of disasters."
Disaster preparedness refers to measures taken to prepare for and reduce the effects of disasters.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to influencing codes, policies and practices so that the conditions that give rise to or influence the severity of public health incidents are reduced or eliminated altogether."

Prevention and mitigation activities refer to influencing codes, policies and practices so that the conditions that give rise to or influence the severity of public health incidents are reduced or eliminated altogether.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reaction to the occurrence of a catastrophic disaster or emergency."
The response phase is a reaction to the occurrence of a catastrophic disaster or emergency.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for promoting, maintaining and protecting this aspect of public health."
EHOs are responsible for promoting, maintaining and protecting this aspect of public health.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the link between environmental factors and health impacts."
Environmental health is the link between environmental factors and health impacts.
